title: Separate the capacitor plates
hook: Change plate separation and predict capacitance.
misconception: capacitance doubles when plate separation doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply C = εA/d to compare capacitance when plate separation changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With ideal parallel plates with fixed area and dielectric permittivity ignoring edge effects, C = εA/d. When plate separation doubles, capacitance becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model C = εA/d; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider ideal parallel plates with fixed area and dielectric permittivity ignoring edge effects, with a nonzero initial result. If plate separation triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on capacitance?
recall.why: Apply C = εA/d under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
